home.tagline: Escape rooms for the classroom. The teacher builds the room, and the students solve the puzzles together to break out.

privacy.title: About data
privacy.intro: eduscape is built to store as little as possible about students and teachers. Here you can read what is stored and when it is deleted.

students.account: Students have no account and never log in. They join with the PIN their teacher shows them.
students.nickname: A student can enter a nickname, such as their first name or initials. It is optional. Apart from that, only the student's team and the scene they are in are stored, so the teacher can follow along.
students.token: The student's browser gets a random key, so the student gets back to their team if the page is reloaded. The server only stores a fingerprint (hash) of the key, not the key itself.
students.answers: What students type as answers is not stored. The server only stores whether the team has solved a lock and how many wrong answers the team has given.
students.noRanking: There is no leaderboard. Time and progress are only shown to the teacher.

deletion.afterClose: Nicknames, keys and scenes are deleted automatically about an hour after the teacher has closed the session. A session that is not closed closes by itself after 12 hours at most.
deletion.sleeping: The deletion runs on the server every 10 minutes. If nobody has used eduscape for a while, the server is asleep, and the deletion happens the next time it wakes up.
deletion.results: The team's result, that is how many locks the team solved and when it broke out, is kept without names, so the teacher can see how it went. The number of students on the team is kept too, but not who they were.
deletion.device: The student's browser forgets the key when the student leaves the session or when the session is closed.

teachers.account: Teachers have an account with an e-mail address and a password. The password is only stored as a fingerprint (hash), never as text.
teachers.content: The server stores the teacher's rooms, classes and an overview of past sessions. A class is only a name, such as “9.A”. Student lists are never stored.
teachers.images: Images a teacher uploads get a new, random file name, and details such as location and camera are removed from the image.
teachers.kept: A teacher's data is kept for as long as the account exists.

where.eu: All data is stored on servers in the EU.
where.noTracking: eduscape uses no tracking cookies, no analytics and no ads. IP addresses and students' answers are not written to the server's logs.
where.browser: The browser only keeps what is needed: the language choice, the student's key and the teacher's login.

startSession.title: Start a session
startSession.classNameHint: E.g. 9.A. The class is used to find the session again later.
startSession.modeTeamDescription: Students choose a team and solve the puzzles together.
startSession.modeIndividualDescription: Each student plays their own game.

session.joinHint: Students go to {{url}} and enter the PIN.
session.statusLocked: Locked – new students cannot join. Students who are already in can keep playing.
session.statusClosed: The session is closed. The PIN no longer works.
session.closeConfirm: Close the session? Students cannot keep playing, and this cannot be undone.
session.showPin: Show the PIN on the board

save.waiting: Not saved – fill in the empty fields

newRoom.title: New room
newRoom.intro: Give the room a title and choose a subject and grade level. You build the rest in the editor.

toolbox.title: For the room
toolbox.hint: Drag onto the picture – or click to place it in the middle.

stage.label: Scene {{scene}}
stage.empty: Drag a lock, a letter or a door onto the picture.

lock.question: Question
lock.questionHint: What students see when they click the lock.

answerTypeDescriptions.Code: Must match character for character, e.g. 0427.
answerTypeDescriptions.Text: Upper and lower case don't matter, and 3,5 is the same as 3.5.
answerTypeDescriptions.MultipleChoice: Students pick one of your answers.

lock.toleranceHint: E.g. 0.01, so rounded results are accepted too.
lock.hintHint: Shown automatically after the team has answered wrong 3 times.

exitDoor.explanation: The exit door opens when every lock in the room is solved. Then the students have escaped.

textBox.textHint: Shown right on the picture, so students can read it without clicking. Good for short pieces of the story, e.g. “The guard has gone to lunch”.

unlockedBy.label: When can students see it?
unlockedBy.hint: This is how you set the order of the room.

scene.title: The scene
scene.name: Name
scene.uploadHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP of at most 10 MB. Details such as location and camera are removed from the image.
scene.narrationPlaceholder: E.g.: It is 1943. You are hiding in the attic, and the soldiers will be here soon …
scene.narrationHint: Shown large to students when they enter the scene. Use it to tell the story and set the mood.

map.title: Map of the scenes
map.noDoors: No doors between the scenes yet.

errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.BAD_REQUEST: The request couldn't be processed. Please try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: What you're looking for doesn't exist.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again shortly.
errors.LOGIN_LOCKED_OUT: Too many wrong attempts. Wait 5 minutes and try again.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this e-mail already exists. Try logging in instead.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The password must be at least 10 characters.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: The password can be at most 128 characters.
errors.PIN_NOT_FOUND: There is no active session with that PIN. Check the code and try again.
errors.DEVICE_NOT_RECOGNIZED: We could not find you in the session. Join again with the PIN.
errors.POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE: The object must be placed inside the image.
errors.LOCK_TOLERANCE_INVALID: A tolerance can only be used with text answers and can't be negative.
errors.LOCK_OPTIONS_INVALID: Multiple choice needs at least two different options.
errors.LOCK_ANSWER_NOT_IN_OPTIONS: The correct answer must be one of the options.
errors.SCENE_NOT_FOUND: The scene doesn't exist in this room.
errors.SESSION_PIN_INVALID: The PIN must be six digits.
errors.SESSION_LOCKED: The teacher has closed the session to new players. Ask your teacher.
errors.PIN_EXPIRED: The PIN has expired. Ask your teacher for a new one.
errors.TEAM_NOT_FOUND: The team does not exist. Choose one of the teams in the list.
errors.PARTICIPANT_NOT_FOUND: The student is no longer in the session.
errors.PARTICIPANT_MOVE_NOT_ALLOWED: Students can only be moved when playing in teams.
errors.OBJECT_NOT_FOUND: The object does not exist in the room.
errors.OBJECT_NOT_AVAILABLE: You cannot use that yet. Solve something else first.
errors.EXIT_DOOR_LOCKED: The exit door is still locked. Solve every lock in the room first.
errors.SCENE_LOCKED: Your team has not unlocked that scene yet.
errors.START_SCENE_MISSING: The room has no start scene.
errors.UNLOCKED_BY_NOT_FOUND: The object is waiting for something that no longer exists in the room.
errors.UNLOCKED_BY_SELF: An object can't wait for itself.
errors.UNLOCKED_BY_INVALID_TARGET: An object can only wait for a lock or a door.
errors.UNLOCKED_BY_CYCLE: The objects are waiting for each other in a loop, so none of them can be unlocked.
errors.DOOR_TARGET_MISSING: The door doesn't lead to a scene.
errors.LOCK_ANSWER_MISSING: The lock needs the correct answer.
errors.EXIT_DOOR_MISSING: The room has no exit door, so students can't break out. Drag an exit door onto the picture.
errors.OBJECT_UNREACHABLE: Students can never get here. No door leads to its scene, or it waits for something that can only be solved later.
errors.SERVER_UNAVAILABLE: The server isn't responding right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.LAST_SCENE: The room needs at least one scene.
errors.IMAGE_KEY_INVALID: The image doesn't exist. Choose another one.
errors.ROOM_INVALID: The room isn't finished yet. Fix the items in the editor first.
errors.ROOM_CHANGED: The room was changed somewhere else. Reload the page to see the latest version.
errors.ID_TAKEN: The change couldn't be saved. Reload the page and try again.
errors.DOCUMENT_INVALID: The change couldn't be saved. Reload the page and try again.
errors.ROOM_TOO_LARGE: The room has become too big. It can have at most 20 scenes and 60 objects per scene.
errors.UPLOADS_UNAVAILABLE: Image uploads aren't switched on yet. Choose one of the built-in backgrounds.
errors.UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND: The image wasn't received. Try uploading it again.
errors.IMAGE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: The image must be a JPEG, PNG or WebP file.
errors.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The image is too big. It can be at most 10 MB and 40 megapixels.
errors.IMAGE_INVALID: The file couldn't be read as an image. Try another file.
